verdict.rationale: Embedding in-person payments in a third-party app is a fair question for a POS and payments product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows the first-party Shopify POS app on iOS and Android, with Tap to Pay, plus POS UI extensions that add custom functionality inside Shopify's own POS interface. That is the reverse direction, not an official mobile SDK for embedding payments in a developer's own app, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed in-person payments into my own iOS or Android app with official mobile SDKs
